mass_chain._policy: RAILCAR LAST-OFFLOAD MASS CONSERVATISM. 2-185 is offload_4 of 4 on railcar GPRX 5188 (last batch — Oil Left in Railcar = 0). BOL inbound aggregate = 26.01 + 26.00 + 26.01 = 78,020 kg. Sum of all 4 offloads' raw scale-ticket Cargo (kg) = 21,509.33 + 22,634.24 + 21,844.99 + 12,419.36 = 78,407.92 kg, which exceeds 78,020 by ~388 kg (physically impossible — can't draw more than was loaded). Per Charm policy: last offload is back-calculated as BOL_aggregate − sum(prior offloads' raw scale tickets) = 78,020 − 65,988.56 = 12,031.44 kg. This policy-applied value flows into Certify. See `lessons_learned.md` Failure Category 11 and `project_railcar_mass_policy.md` in memory.
mass_chain._railcar_balance_check: Sum of all offload Cargo (kg) in 2-185 Ops Notes = 21,509.33 + 22,634.24 + 21,844.99 + 12,031.44 = 78,020.00 kg = BOL aggregate exactly. Policy-applied; PASS.
mass_chain._cobb_divergence_expected: COBB by design carries raw operator-entered scale-ticket values, not the policy-applied figure. COBB row 62 (2-185) shows 12,419.35 (≈ raw axle-sum scale ticket). This divergence from Ops Notes (12,031.44) is by design — operators have a consistent procedure (record raw scale tickets); MRV applies the policy downstream. The verifier looks at Ops Notes/Certify, not COBB.
mass_chain._cobb_2_184_inconsistency: Note: COBB row 61 (sister batch 2-184) shows 21,457.08 kg, which doesn't match the raw scale-ticket math (21,844.99 kg) for that offload. This is a COBB-side data-provenance issue (probably an Ops/Manufacturo automation glitch) that Max is handling directly with Garrett. Not verifier-impacting; not a 2-185 finding. Surfacing here for traceability.
mass_chain.verdict: Mass chain is policy-correct. Ops Notes 12,031.44 → sparging 155.21 → Mass of Injectant 11,876.23 → Certify 18.770 t gross → Net 17.094 tCO2e. No material finding.

uncertainty_per_component._FC9_check: PASS - per-removal framing applied correctly. N_offloads (4) >= N_BOLs (3) for railcar GPRX 5188 -> conservatism precondition satisfied (Section 8 last-batch check).

cross_check_summary._material_finding: NONE. Initial QA misclassified the policy-applied last-offload mass as a 388-kg under-credit error. Max corrected: the 12,031.44 kg in Ops Notes IS the policy-applied figure (BOL_aggregate - sum(prior offloads' raw scale tickets)) and is correct. Net 17.094 tCO2e is correct. The discrepancy I initially flagged is the very thing the policy is designed to produce.
